tours.title: Sunrise Taj Mahal Tour With Female Guide
tours.shortDescription: Experience the most beautiful monument in the world
tours.fullDescription:
Overview of your Agra tour:
Taj Mahal Timeless and priceless monument….

Sunrise tour is not only visiting a monument but to experience the best place at the right time to have lifetime memories to cherish. Early morning we enjoy heavenly view of the Taj Mahal with the calmness of the morning, singing of birds, morning soothing light for photos, cool weather and less crowd.

NOTE
* Time of tour can be vary according to local sunrise time.
* Taj Mahal remains closed on every Friday.
* Early morning is the only time we have less crowd.
* To take advantage of this tour you must be in Agra a night before.
* Do not get confused with the word sunrise Taj Mahal, it does not mean that you are coming to see sunrise from Taj Mahal, here you will experience the Taj Mahal in sunrise time to get soothing light on to the marble for good photos in the presence of less people.
* I can also Guide you in other cities, for quote, please contact.
* This is a fully customized tour, I will be happy to draft it, message me to discuss to create the best.

tours.title: Delhi-Agra Taj Mahal-Delhi Same Day Tour
tours.shortDescription: Embark On A Memorable Day With Your Local Guide
tours.fullDescription:
Your Agra tour itinerary

* Driver will pick you at 6am. from hotel to avoid the rush hour, drive to Agra by large Crysta/Innova air conditioned car.
* I will meet you in Agra.
* We start our tour with the visit of "Taj Mahal"
* Lunch break.
* After lunch, visit marble inlaid demonstration where we see the making of Taj Mahal and rugs making also get the opportunity to meet the local artist, they are the direct descendants of those artisan who worked over the Taj Mahal.
* My guide service will end here in Agra and driver will drop you back in Delhi hotel/airport.

NOTE:
* Only the driver accompanies you during the transfer.
* If pickup and drop are included in tour, it must be within the main city 10km (few hotels are too far in countryside areas) if distance is more than 10km. extra charges will be apply.
* If you wish to add more places other than itinerary, INR 1000 will be charged per sightseeing, please contact me for quote.

tours.title: Female Guide For Taj Mahal
tours.shortDescription: This is the best eample of Mughal architecture to eperience, you will have to be here in person as no photo or video can do justice with real
tours.fullDescription:
* I will come to meet you at the place mentioned by you while booking the tour for example it could be, train station/bus station/airport/hotel or any other place within Agra.
* We start this tour early morning with the visit of "Taj Mahal"
* After visit of Taj Mahal, back to hotel to have breakfast.
* Thereafter we go to enjoy an old age technique to cut the stone, where we see the making of Taj Mahal, also get the opportunity to meet local artist, they are the direct descendants of those artisan who worked over the Taj Mahal and much more.
* Lunch in a local restaurant (paid by you).
* Drop at the decided place within Agra.

NOTE
* This is my suggested itinerary, I would love to customize it according your choice.
